CEDC Graduate Admissions
Apply
Elevate your expertise, expand your career opportunities, and make a lasting impact at the University of Colorado Denver’s College of Engineering, Design and Computing (CEDC). Explore specialized master’s and doctoral programs designed to strengthen your technical skills, research capabilities, and professional potential.
Graduate Application Requirements
All CEDC engineering graduate applicants must submit the following materials.
Required Application Materials
Application – Complete the online graduate application.
Application fee – $50 for domestic applicants; $75 for international applicants.
Statement of purpose – Submit an original essay with your application. Scanned copies are not accepted.
Resume – Submit a current resume with your application.
Official transcripts – Provide one official transcript from each previously attended institution. Send electronic transcripts to [email protected].
Explore Graduate Programs
Apply
Program-Specific Application Requirements
Letters of Recommendation
Mechanical Engineering and Computer Science: Two letters required.
Biomedical Engineering: Three letters required.
Electrical Engineering: Not required for internal applicants; optional for external applicants.
Biomedical Engineering Applicants: Complete additional essay questions and the Applicant Background Survey.
Visit the Biomedical MS and PhD Program pages for more info.
GRE Scores (Optional)
GRE scores are not considered in admission decisions. Applicants who choose to submit scores should request official delivery through ETS.
Institution code: 4875
Preferred minimum: 300+
Important Information
Academic integrity: Written application materials are scanned for plagiarism and added to a local plagiarism-detection database.
Funding: Financial support is not guaranteed. Applicants are encouraged to explore external funding opportunities.

International Graduate Applicants
International applicants must meet CEDC’s graduate admission requirements and demonstrate English language proficiency, when applicable.
Office of International Admissions
English Language Proficiency (ELP) requirements
Applicants from non-English-speaking countries may be required to provide proof of English language proficiency.
For accepted tests, score requirements, submission instructions, and additional details, visit the International Graduate Admissions page.
TOEFL IBT
Minimum overall score: 79
Reading: 8
Listening: 7
Speaking: 18
Writing: 16
IELTS Academic
Minimum overall band score: 6.5
Reading: 5.5
Listening: 5.5
Speaking: 5.5
Writing: 5.5
PTE Academic
Minimum overall score: 58
Reading: 42
Listening: 42
Speaking: 42
Writing: 42
Duolingo English Test
Minimum overall score: 105
Literacy: 85
Conversation: 85
Comprehension: 85
Production: 85
Please follow these instructions to send your Duolingo scores officially through the website.
ELP Waivers and Exemptions
Applicants who have graduated from the CU Denver ESL Academy may qualify for a TOEFL/IELTS waiver.
Additional exemptions may apply based on citizenship, country of origin, or special circumstances. Review English proficiency exemptions.
Score Processing: Allow up to three weeks after your test date for GRE and English proficiency scores to appear in your student portal.
